g.text: HOPPER WELDMENT 42 L, LID AND FLAP (PRODUCT CONTACT)
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
SS 316L (ASTM A240 sheet/plate, A270 tube), 14 ga (1.9) / 16 ga (1.5)
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: 405 LID PLAN (1:4): 2 HALVES, SPLIT ON X = 0

g.text: weld studs; actuator on the flap
LAP STRIP 20 x 1.5 on the right half

svg.text: slant 357.8; roll to Ø451.9 / Ø62.1 mean
316L angle 25 x 25 x 3, rolled leg out, ID 453.8; 2 x Ø9
316L 16 ga (1.5); skirt 15 rolled; collar Ø83 x 25
full penetration, inside ground flush Ra ≤ 0.8
full pen., inside ground; ⟂ A, concentric 0.5
outside fillet 2; top inside seal, ground (no crevice)
continuous outside, ground; lid inside smooth
1. Volume 42.2 L to the rim (23 kg of blend); cone 57° from horizontal for mass flow of a 0.54 g/mL blend (P1-401-900).
2. Fit the ferrule on a mandrel through the cone so its axis is the cone axis; weld W3 before W1. Check the TC face square to the rim top (1.0).
3. Product contact (inside, lid underside, flap underside): Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin], welds ground flush, no crevices; electropolish optional. Passivate ASTM A967.
4. The hopper hangs on the horseshoe by the rim angle and 2 pins: lift 13 to clear the pins, slide forward through the opening with the tooling removed.
